sloka: यथा क्रमम् ततः पाणिम् जग्राह रघुनंदन ।ब्रह्मदत्तो महीपालः तासाम् देवपतिर् यथा ॥१-३३-२२॥
transliteration: yathā kramam tataḥ pāṇim jagrāha raghunaṁdana ।brahmadatto mahīpālaḥ tāsām devapatir yathā ॥1-33-22॥

translations.english: O son of Raghu's dynasty that king Brahmadatta resembling Indra received the hands of those maidens' in due order.
